events.what: Chen, Ghomi and Wang prove the Cartan-Hadamard conjecture in dimension 5
Chen, Ghomi and Wang extend the method to a unified proof in dimensions 3-9
events.credibility_reason: Record notes the argument leans on a regularity lemma (Ghomi-Spruck Lemma 7.2) established only up to dimension 7, so dimensions 8-9 may depend on an unproved step; the source for this is a secondary (possibly automated) summary.

events.what: Wheeler proves the isoperimetric inequality under an added curvature-pinching hypothesis
Agnoletto, Da Silva, Nardulli, Resende prove the small-volume case under a lower Ricci bound

judgement.doubts: Both Chen-Ghomi-Wang events are `case` (partial); even if the 3-9 extension fails in 8-9, dimension 5 alone keeps the status partial, which is why the record's event points to the dimension-5 paper. The AI disclosure ('used in the preparation of this manuscript') attributes no mathematics to the models: ai_role none, agreeing with the record. The earlier human correction from claimed to partial is correct (F1). Wheeler and Agnoletto et al. add hypotheses and are variants.
